New Post-Doctoral Position Opening

The Interactive Graphics and Simulation (IGS) Group, Department
of Computer Science, at University of Innsbruck, Austria, invites
applications for the position of a full-time post-doctoral researcher
(fixed duration, substitute position).

We are seeking a highly-qualified individual with interest and skill
in fields related to the research themes of the IGS group. This could
include, but is not limited to: computer graphics, physically-based
simulation, surgical planning/support/training, virtual/augmented
reality.

Candidates should have earned a doctoral degree in a relevant field
(Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Mechatronics, Biomechanics
or other related areas), possess a publication record commensurate
with experience, and have demonstrated strengths in some of the
interest domains of the IGS group, as outlined above. Knowledge and
experience in programming e.g. in C/C++/Python is sought, as well
as a good level in English, both written and spoken. Experience in
teaching and project management is a benefit.

The search is open immediately (application deadline November 25,
2026). The position is initially offered for a duration of up to
one year, on the level of non-permanent university research staff
(as a fixed duration substitute). Applications can be submitted online:

Note that the position includes a teaching component, covering
courses in the BSc and MSc program in Computer Science. In this
regard, appropriate knowledge of German for teaching is desired.

Applications comprise a motivation letter, research outline,
curriculum vitae with a publication list, URLs to 2-3 selected
publications (online only), contact information of at least
three references, and scans of relevant degree documents.

Please feel free to get in contact in case of questions:

Prof. Dr. Matthias Harders
Department of Computer Science
University of Innsbruck
Austria
